verses.37:47: لَا فِيهَا غَوۡلࣱ وَلَا هُمۡ عَنۡهَا يُنزَفُونَ

en_note: Statistically derived from translation co-occurrence, not a lexical definition. Highlighting only.
meaning: The root غَالَ (ghāla) denotes seizing a thing unawares. Ibn Fāris gives its core as ختل وأخذ من حيث لا يدرى — taking by stealth from where one does not perceive; whence الغُول, a creature imagined to snatch travellers, and اغتيال, assassination.
meaning_source: Derived from the classical dictionaries (chiefly Maqayis al-Lugha, Ibn Faris d.1004) held in lexicon_full/
